personas.standsFor: A sighted customer using a mouse, with no assistive technology.

method.control: The baseline persona is the control. It perceives the rendered page and uses a pointer. accounting.costBasis: Token counts are measured. The dollar figure is those counts multiplied by published list price, so it is arithmetic rather than a billed amount.
